name: Unit Price 24
definition: Amount of money for which goods or services are offered, sold, or bought.

PriceType.name: Price Type
PriceType.definition: Type and information about a price.

ValueInInvestmentCurrency.name: Value In Investment Currency
ValueInInvestmentCurrency.definition: Value of the price, eg, as a currency and value.

ValueInAlternativeCurrency.name: Value In Alternative Currency
ValueInAlternativeCurrency.definition: Value of the price, eg, as a currency and value.

ForExecutionIndicator.name: For Execution Indicator
ForExecutionIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the price information can be used for the execution of a transaction.

CumDividendIndicator.name: Cum Dividend Indicator
CumDividendIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the dividend is included, ie, cum-dividend, in the price. When the dividend is not included, the price will be ex-dividend.

CalculationBasis.name: Calculation Basis
CalculationBasis.definition: Ratio applied on the non-adjusted price.

EstimatedPriceIndicator.name: Estimated Price Indicator
EstimatedPriceIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the price is an estimated price.

NumberOfDaysAccrued.name: Number Of Days Accrued
NumberOfDaysAccrued.definition: Specifies the number of days from trade date that the counterparty on the other side of the trade should "given up" or divulged.

TaxableIncomePerShare.name: Taxable Income Per Share
TaxableIncomePerShare.definition: Amount included in the NAV that corresponds to gains directly or indirectly derived from interest payment in the scope of the European Directive on taxation of savings income in the form of interest payments.

TaxableIncomePerShareCalculated.name: Taxable Income Per Share Calculated
TaxableIncomePerShareCalculated.definition: Specifies whether the fund calculates a taxable interest per share (TIS).

TaxableIncomePerDividend.name: Taxable Income Per Dividend
TaxableIncomePerDividend.definition: Amount included in the dividend that corresponds to gains directly or indirectly derived from interest payment in the scope of the European Directive on taxation of savings income in the form of interest payments.

EUDividendStatus.name: EU Dividend Status
EUDividendStatus.definition: Specifies whether dividend is in the scope of the European directive on taxation of savings income in the form of interest payments (Council Directive 2003/48/EC 3 June), or an income realised upon sale, a refund or redemption of shares and units, etc.

ChargeDetails.name: Charge Details
ChargeDetails.definition: Amount of money associated with a service.

TaxLiabilityDetails.name: Tax Liability Details
TaxLiabilityDetails.definition: Information related to taxes that are due.

TaxRefundDetails.name: Tax Refund Details
TaxRefundDetails.definition: Information related to taxes that are paid back.

CalculationBasisRule.definition: If Type is not NonAdjustedUnpublished, then CalculationBasis is not allowed. If Type is NonAdjustedUnpublished, then CalculationBasis may be present.
